def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is one file name with no directory parts, no dot-dot, and no separators."""
    ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("../a.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("sub/a.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("sub\\a.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("..") == False
    ex is_plain_name("") == False
    return name != "" and name != "." and name != ".." and "/" not in name and "\\" not in name

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the file `name` inside the directory notes. Returns "" when the file is missing, unreadable, or the name is not a plain file name, so nothing outside notes is ever read."""
    post out == "" or out.byte_len() > 0
    if not is_plain_name(name):
        return ""
    text = ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        text = fs.read(name) else ""
    return text
